findings.issue: Featured sections used a rounded colored wrapper around image cards.
findings.correction: Replace wrapper cards with full-width section bands and normal inner layout.

findings.issue: Yellow and beige visual treatment felt ad hoc.
findings.correction: Remove yellow tokens and limit color to approved creative tokens and soft bands.

findings.issue: Gallery media showed colored backing around previews and used thumbnail-first preview URLs.
findings.correction: Use PNG preview first for cards and white paper media wells with no visible padding.

findings.issue: PNG and SVG controls competed with Print as primary pills.
findings.correction: Keep Print visible and collapse downloading to one quiet secondary action.

findings.issue: Some public titles exposed AI export names.
findings.correction: Apply public display title overrides without renaming files.
